summary: Create an agri-food sustainability baseline, screen Scope 3 sources and prepare an action scorecard. View the five-day course outline.
lede: Agri-food chain sustainability involves assessing and improving environmental, social and economic performance across farm, processing and distribution activities. This foundation course is for sustainability coordinators, agricultural operations managers and food supply-chain analysts who need a practical baseline; it covers mapping chain boundaries, selecting indicators, organizing records, screening Scope 3 emissions and prioritizing improvements in an action scorecard.
audienceIntro: This foundation course is designed for professionals who collect, coordinate or use sustainability information across farms, food processing and distribution. It is useful if you need to turn operational records into a baseline, identify gaps and prepare realistic improvement priorities.
prerequisites: Basic familiarity with agricultural, food-processing, logistics or retail operations is useful. No coding is required. Bring a laptop with Excel available; the course uses a provided workbook and sample dataset.
